# app/controllers/api/v1/documents_controller.rb
class Api::V1::DocumentsController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_api_key!
  before_action :set_base_path

  # GET /api/v1/documents/:path
  # Retrieves document content for authorized API consumers
  def show
    relative_path = params[:path]
    
    # Sanitize: remove null bytes and normalize
    sanitized = relative_path.to_s.gsub(/\x00/, '').strip
    
    # Build full path
    full_path = File.join(@base_path, sanitized)
    
    # Resolve symlinks for the base path check
    resolved_base = File.realpath(@base_path)
    
    # Check if file exists before realpath to avoid errors on missing files
    unless File.exist?(full_path)
      return render json: { error: 'Document not found' }, status: :not_found
    end
    
    resolved_path = File.realpath(full_path)
    
    # Verify the resolved path is within allowed directory
    unless resolved_path.start_with?(resolved_base)
      Rails.logger.warn("Path traversal attempt blocked: #{relative_path}")
      return render json: { error: 'Access denied' }, status: :forbidden
    end
    
    content = File.read(resolved_path)
    
    # If the document contains cloud metadata, enrich with instance info
    if content.include?('instance-id') || params[:enrich] == 'true'
      metadata = fetch_instance_metadata
      render json: { content: content, metadata: metadata }
    else
      render json: { content: content }
    end
  end

  # POST /api/v1/documents/export
  # Exports document to external webhook
  def export
    relative_path = params[:path]
    webhook_url = params[:webhook_url]
    
    sanitized = relative_path.to_s.gsub(/\x00/, '').strip
    full_path = File.join(@base_path, sanitized)
    
    unless File.exist?(full_path)
      return render json: { error: 'Document not found' }, status: :not_found
    end
    
    content = File.read(full_path)
    
    # Send to webhook - used for integration with external doc systems
    if webhook_url.present?
      uri = URI.parse(webhook_url)
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.open_timeout = 5
      http.read_timeout = 5
      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.path)
      request.body = { document: content, source: full_path }.to_json
      request['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      response = http.request(request)
      render json: { status: 'exported', response_code: response.code }
    else
      render json: { error: 'webhook_url required' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
    end
  end

  private

  def set_base_path
    @base_path = ENV.fetch('DOCUMENT_ROOT', '/app/storage/documents')
  end

  def authenticate_api_key!
    api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
    unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.active.exists?(key: api_key)
      render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
    end
  end

  def fetch_instance_metadata
    # Fetch EC2/cloud metadata for document enrichment
    uri = URI.parse('http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/')
    http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
    http.open_timeout = 2
    http.read_timeout = 2
    response = http.request(Net::HTTP::Get.new(uri.path))
    JSON.parse(response.body) rescue { raw: response.body }
  rescue StandardError => e
    { error: "metadata unavailable: #{e.message}" }
  end
end

environment.description: Ruby on Rails 7.1 application deployed on AWS EKS (Kubernetes 1.28) running as a pod in the 'documents-api' namespace. The pod runs with default service account, no resource quotas enforced. The DOCUMENT_ROOT is set to /app/storage/documents. The cluster uses AWS VPC CNI plugin with default configuration. No NetworkPolicy objects are applied to the namespace. The node's IMDS (Instance Metadata Service) is accessible at 169.254.169.254 with IMDSv1 enabled (no token required). Pod has unrestricted egress network access.
